en: Hmm... something is definitely\nwrong, Captain.

Good work, Captain. I thought
we were scheduled to arrive at
the next planet soon. Are we
running late?

We need to restock our food,
and I was hoping we could do a
little sightseeing while we were
shopping...
Ah, Fayt, Rena. Actually...
Wait, what do you mean the\nship isn't moving? We're still\nmoving forward, aren't we?

Yes, the ship itself is moving
forward. However, after
traveling a certain distance, we
end up back at the same
coordinates.
That's impossible... It's not like\nwe're at the edge of the\nscreen in an early RPG.

I believe those video games are
from over 800 years before
the era you were born in,
Fayt... you're quite
knowledgeable.
Retro games are surprisingly\ndeep. I've been really into them\nlately.

A-anyway, at first I suspected
an instrument failure... but it
seems the cause lies within
this sector, the <font color=yellow>Starbirth</font>.

The Starbirth sector...? A place
where stars are born. It
certainly sounds like the kind
of place where strange things
would happen...
Whoa, what was that?! Did the\nship hit something?

No, that can't be! There
shouldn't have been any
celestial bodies nearby for us
to collide with...!
Hwahwahwah!! The external\ncameras and sensors aren't\nfunctioning at all!!

You're right, looks like we have
no choice but to go check it
out in person. Captain, I'll help
you.
Ah, I'm coming too! Coro,\nplease keep investigating the\ncause from here.
W-what is this...!?
Evelysse: I shall shine like a brilliant\nstar!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Audience: Oooooh!! Evelysse! Evelysse!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Don't you dare blink, now!
Come on, dance along with us!
Audience: Oooooh!! Our Milky\nQuintet!
A Milky Quintet concert!?\nW-when did this even happen!?\nAnd what is everyone doing!?
Why is Sophia...!? And why is\nEvelysse on stage!? She's supposed\nto be...!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Fayt! That's not the real Evelysse\nover there. And neither am I, or\nMiki and the others.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Sophia! Why are you behind\nme...!? What on earth is going\non here...?
Thank you all for the energy!\nNow, I wonder what the judges'\ndecision is?
Audience: Oooooh!! Evelysse! Evelysse!\nOur Milky Quintet!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: ...Evelysse is the only one left on\nstage!?
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: ...I wonder if this is based on\nsome kind of Idol Audition?
Come on, Head Judge! What's\nthe result!?

Head Judge: An idol with such
a scary face? Non, non! Come
on, give us a smile! A big,
bright smile!
Wait! Is that Givel!?
He... seems to have a very\ndifferent vibe here...
Head Judge: Now then, I shall\nannounce the results of this\naudition!
Head Judge: Too bad! Once\nagain, no galactic-class idol\nstar has been born!
Aww... how disappointing!

And with that, the Starbirth
Idol Audition is officially over!
Look forward to the next one!
♪
Evelysse, that weird Givel... and all\nthose people in the audience...\nthey're all gone?
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
Captain, Captain! I've figured it
out! In this sector of space,
human spirits and memories
seem to have a strong
influence on the environment.
Strong emotions can manifest\nas physical forms of residual\nthoughts...
...Yeah. I just saw it happen. A\nscene born from residual\nthoughts.
You mean that stage just now\nwas Evelysse's residual thought? No\nway, that can't be!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: ...I feel the same way.
Evelysse looked like she was having\nso much fun when we all\nperformed together.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Right, we can't linger here. We\nneed to track down the real\nEvelysse, not a residual thought.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
You're right. Those residual
thoughts are intriguing, but
they've vanished for now, so
let's find an exit quickly...

Hm... hmmm? E-everyone, we
have a problem! Not just the
coordinates, but time... time is
rewinding!
...What...!? Y-you mean...!

Head Judge: Shine bright! The
Starbirth specialty! The Idol
Audition! Kittens, thanks for
waiting! It's that time of the
week again!♪
Evelysse's Afterimage: Entry number\none! Milky Quintet! We're\nsinging!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Audience: Oooooh!! Evelysse! Evelysse!\nOur Milky Quintet!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: The Evelysse afterimages that\ndisappeared are back...?\nWhat's going on!?
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: You mean not just the location,\nbut time itself is looping over\nand over...?
It's almost like Evelysse's\nafterimages are telling us not\nto leave them behind...
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
And that's why the real Milky
Quintet―now the Milky
Quartet―is reuniting, even if
it's just the four of us!
We can't let the fake Milky\nbeat us!
I see. Since we're at the\naudition venue, you've decided\nto just go ahead and enter.

Yeah! If we put on a
passionate performance like we
did back then, maybe Evelysse's
lingering spirit will be satisfied...
nyan!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: That sloppy way you end your\nsentences, Sophia... brings\nback memories.
Wait! This feeling... it's almost\ntime.

Head Judge: Shine bright! The
Starbirth specialty! The Idol
Audition! Sorry to keep you
waiting, kittens! It's that time of
the week again♪

Head Judge: Now then, let's
start with the challengers over
there♪ Come on, come on, get
yourselves up on stage!
All right, everyone, let's go.\nWe'll put all our feelings into\nour song...!
Head Judge: Disqualified.

Huh? What's happening...? I
can't dance as well as I used
to, and I can't get my voice
out...!

Well, we haven't practiced
much lately. The arts truly do
wither if one does not
persevere...

Compared to them, Evelysse and
the others are the most
brilliant version of the quintet
from Evelysse's memories. T-there's
no way we can win...
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
But there's no reason the real
thing should lose to a memory
of the past. We have to do
something...

It is the destiny of those
disqualified to leave the stage
immediately... And for naughty
little kittens who can't follow
the rules...
It's time for your punishment!!!
Kyaaaa!!!
Are you okay, Sophia!
I'm okay. Thanks, Fayt...

You don't have to look so
down. If we're out of practice,
we just need to practice more.
We have plenty of time, so...
...Being in the Audition made\nme realize... I have a feeling\nthat we just can't pass.

Even the phantoms of us at
our peak led by Evelysse couldn't
pass this Audition, so the four
of us, out of practice...
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
Furthermore, judging by Givel's
behavior, it seems Evelysse's
lingering will is stubbornly
trying to protect this memory.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
She might have failed the
audition and now wishes for
this live performance to last
forever...

Yeah, the Evelysse standing on that
stage might be a happy
memory that the current Evelysse
has cast aside.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Just constantly reminiscing\nabout happy memories... that\nwould be boring, and sad.

...Yes, you're right. And all
within a single person's
memories... with no one to
share them with. If this
continues, she'll be alone for
tens of thousands of years...

Coro, could you put together
some idol outfits for me? I
want to try out for the
Audition.
What? Fayt, you do?

Can I try too? A phantom
stage, phantom comrades... I
want to help Evelysse, who
continues to perform alone
among them.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Because being all alone is so\npainful...
Rena...

Understood! Based on every
piece of information in my
database, I shall prepare the
strongest idol outfits in the
galaxy!

So this is my idol outfit. It's a
bit embarrassing... but I guess
it's better to just go all out
with this kind of thing.
How about this?
Kyaaa!!! Fayt, you look\nwonderful!!!
How about my outfit?

Whoa! Rena, you're so cute!! Is
that moon-shaped machine
something you can actually
ride?
Yes, it's the Crescent Flip.\nVerda made it for me so I can\nperform using the whole stage.
Mufufu, I must say, it was a\nbrilliant idea!

Now that we've checked the
costumes, let's start with vocal
training. I'm going to be strict,
so be prepared!
Fayt & Rena: Yes, ma'am!
*Sigh*...
You look pretty exhausted.

Being an idol is harder than I
thought. It uses completely
different muscles than Battles
or basketball, and now I'm so
sore. Ow, ow, ow...

Back when I was in Faykreed, I
tried my hand at sword
dancing, and I remember
feeling just like you do now,
Fayt.
I guess that's just how it goes\nwhen you try something new.

But the more difficult the
challenge, the greater the
sense of achievement when
you conquer it.
Just like in a game.
Haha, true! For our sake―and\nfor Evelysse's―I can't just spend all\nmy time resting.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Alright, watch me, Fidel. I'm\ngoing to try the whole routine!
*Phew*... So, how was it, Fidel?
I don't know much about\nsinging and dancing, but...
Fayt... are you actually feeling\na bit shy?
Ah... you can tell, huh?

Yeah, your movements got
smaller during the climax and
your eyes were darting around,
so I figured that was it.
I knew you'd notice... I'm not\nlying about wanting to become\nan idol to save Evelysse, but...
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Now that I'm actually doing it,\nI'm getting more and more\nembarrassed.
But I guess this is something I\nhave to figure out on my own.
In that case, how about trying\nto fully immerse yourself in the\n"idol" character?
I'm not an actor, I can't just do\nthat.
But I think you have talent,\nFayt...
What do you mean?

Well, when you get competitive
playing games, you always get
into character and shout the
names of the special moves,
right?
...What?
Oh? You didn't realize you did\nthat?
N-no way... I've been acting like\nsome adolescent kid without\neven realizing it...!
I-it's okay! Everyone's already\naccepted that's just how it is!
...So I've been showing that\nside of myself to everyone, not\njust you, Fidel...

D-don't get depressed!! I think
it's actually a very useful talent
for this... N-now, we have to
get back to practicing!
Ugh... now I'm starting to feel\nseriously embarrassed...

I don't mind Sophia, but I
wonder what Cliff and Maria
think of me singing and
dancing...
No, Albel is probably looking at\nme with total contempt...!
Fayt! Everyone knows the\nsituation, so it's really okay!!
Oh, that reminds me, Reimi and\nthe others' idol personas were\nknown across multiple planets...
If footage of me as an idol\nleaked online and my friends\nfrom college saw it...
Ah... I can't take it... I can't bear\nthe thought...
Fayt!!! Pull yourself together!!!

I messed up in the same spot
again... I just can't get the
choreography before the
chorus to flow smoothly...
Rena, why don't you take a\nlittle break? I brought some\ndrinks.
Thank you, Ilia, but I'm okay for\nnow.
(...I can't take a break until I've\nmastered this part...)
All right, one more time!
Hey, don't stop the music, Ilia!\nI'm still practicing!!
Rena, idols need rest too. If\nyou push yourself too hard,\nyou won't make progress.
But I can't just give up while\nI'm still struggling...
Resting and giving up are two\ncompletely different things.
Here, have a drink first.
Then, close your eyes and\nthink about something other\nthan singing or dancing.

...Right now, my head is just
filled with thoughts of the
Audition. I can't imagine
thinking about anything else...
Let's try to force it. Now, first,\nclose your eyes.

Now, what should we think
about? ...For example, maybe
something like, "I really want
steak for dinner tonight~"

Claude would be so happy if it
were steak... I suppose I
wouldn't mind giving him a
slice...
Hehe...

Did you just picture Rena's
face as she happily stuffs her
cheeks? Speaking of which, I
wonder what Claude is doing
right no―
...Wait! Why is it all about\nClaude!?
Oh, did you not like that?
No, it's not that I didn't like it...
So, how are you feeling now?
Oh...
Don't you feel like you can\nproperly dance the part you\nwere stuck on earlier now?
You're right! I feel like a weight\nhas been lifted from my mind!
That's proof that you've\nproperly refreshed yourself! I'm\nglad.

I don't know much about being
an idol, but when I hit a wall
with my research, I make it a
point to relax and think about
something else.

When I do, a solution from a
completely different angle
often comes to me out of
nowhere, and I'm surprised that
I ever struggled in the first
place.

It's exactly like you said, Ilia!
Come to think of it, I think I
was doing that Step slightly
wrong! That's why the rhythm
felt off...
Really? The world of idols is\nquite profound. I didn't notice\nat all.

Would you mind watching me?
I'll dance the whole thing
through! I want to show you a
perfect performance, Ilia!

I wonder how many days it's
been since Fayt and Rena
started their Audition. Fail
after fail, fail after fail...
There was even that time they\nfailed spectacularly and got\npunished!
...Still, their evaluations have\nbeen improving. Let's keep our\nhopes up for this time.
Time is rewinding... Now, the\nAudition begins again. Let's\npass today!
Even though I've done this so\nmany times, I still get nervous\nbefore it starts...

The method Ilia taught me to
relieve tension is to write the
character for "person" on my
palm and then swallow...
Last time, it felt like you were\njust one step away...
I think I got too comfortable\nand let my guard down at the\nend, which is why I messed up...
As for me, I was so nervous\nthat I messed up the\nbeginning...
Fayt, Rena, wouldn't it be\nbetter to enter as a team\nrather than doing solos?

That's actually a great idea! It
would probably ease the
nerves, and any mistakes
wouldn't be as noticeable!
No. I don't think we can pass\nthis Audition that way.
You're right, Rena. I agree.
Why is that? A team could put\non a much flashier\nperformance.

The Evelysse who remains in this
place may be on stage as part
of the Milky Quintet, but she's
all alone.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Being surrounded by phantoms\nof her friends might only be\ndeepening her loneliness.
That's why we, as her\nopponents, have to face that\nloneliness and overcome it.

I have to show that Evelysse that a
happy future is waiting for her
once she moves past her
solitude!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: To think I was so close to Evelysse\nand yet failed to notice such a\nthing...
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Sometimes, being close is\nexactly why you don't notice.

That's why all of us in
GFSS-3214F have to help
each other and keep moving
forward.
Verda, and everyone in the\nMilky Quartet, leave this to us!
I will definitely free the Evelysse\nwho remains here from her\nloneliness!!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
Head Judge: Shine bright! The
pride of Starbirth! The Idol
Audition! Sorry to keep you
waiting, kittens! It's that time of
the week again♪
All right, let's go.
Yeah, this time we're definitely\npassing and freeing Evelysse's\nlingering spirit from this place!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Head Judge: My, my, Milky\nQuintet. What's the matter?\nThe music has stopped!

Head Judge: For a naughty
little kitten who stops singing
while the fans are waiting... it's
time for a punishment...
...Evelysse?
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: What's wrong? It's like she's\nwaiting for something...
Fayt, now!
Yeah! Now's the time!
Let's step forward, into the\nworld of dreams!
We won't stop! Nothing will\nchange if we just keep running\naway!

Head Judge: Oh! This is... an
intrusion! An intrusion! For the
naughty little kittens
interrupting Evelysse's stage...
Evelysse's Residual Will: Don't stop\nit! The concert isn't over yet!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Head Judge: Eh? Ah... yes...
Audience: OOOOOOH!!

I knew it... Evelysse's residual
thoughts want to stay as they
are, but at the same time,
they're searching for something
else.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: This surge from the crowd is a\nreflection of that expectation.
Now is the time to let my song\nreach her!
My true self
I want to face it
I know it might hurt
But if I keep running
Nothing will ever change
I will move forward

(Evelysse's residual thoughts... no,
Evelysse...! Can you hear me? Is it
reaching you? My song... my
feelings!)
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Audience: OOOOO!!
Thank you for listening! ...Now\nit's your turn, Fayt!
Yeah, leave it to me! I'll remind\nyou how exciting and wonderful\nthe future can be!
These unchanging, boring\ndays...
I'm sick and tired of them.
Let's break free.
Huddled in a tiny room...
Pretending to understand...

(Evelysse, even as a residual
thought, you must know. No
matter how many times we
repeat a successful stage, it
can't bring the joy of a real
memory.)
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: (Only the infinite future of the\nstory we've begun... is truly\nexciting and full of hope!)
Audience: Ooooooh!!

Head Judge: S-stop it! Stop
disrupting the stage! T-the
space is... warping... W-what a
naughty little kitten... you are.
You're not stopping us! This is\nour concert!
Evelysse, you can feel it, right? Our\nfeelings. Please, answer us!!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Evelysse's Residual Will: ...Rena,\nFayt. That was a wonderful\nperformance.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Evelysse's Residual Will: Reimi,\nVerda, Miki... Sophia... and\nCaptain. Thank you all, truly.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Evelysse's Residual Will: I... I... too...
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Evelysse...!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
This is bad! Evelysse's residual will
has abandoned its existence in
this stagnant space! It's
collapsing!! Everyone, hurry
back to the ship!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Evelysse! Come with us!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
Evelysse's Residual Will: I am not
your Evelysse. The Evelysse who needs
to be recovered is surely
waiting.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Even so, there's no way we can\njust leave you behind! Come\non, reach out your hand!!
Evelysse's Residual Will: Thank you...\nfor showing me hope... I was\ntruly happy...
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Evelysse's Residual Will: ...I'll... be...\nwaiting...
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
I am glad everyone is safe. The
space-time anomaly has
vanished, so we can now
proceed to our original
destination.
That stage from before... it's\ncompletely disappeared.

I'd rather move toward an
infinite future than stay
submerged in the same
memory forever. ...If it were the
Evelysse we know, I'm sure that's
what she would want.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
That's why that stage of
memories fulfilled its purpose...
and vanished. At least, that's
what I want to believe.
You're right. We have to keep\nmoving toward the future!

This story has now come to an
end. More stories are planned
for release in the future.
Please look forward to them.
